The '''Parwa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planet [[Parwa/Legends|Parwa]], homeworld of the [[Parwan/Legends|Parwans]].
